brief:
A new documentary from Zeteo follows Gaza's healthcare workers amid the ongoing conflict, documenting both those killed and those continuing to work despite deteriorating conditions. The film aims to preserve the legacy of medical personnel operating under extreme strain during the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.

Healthcare providers have remained in the territory despite widespread casualties and infrastructure collapse affecting the sector.
dek: Gaza’s healthcare workers, those killed and those still alive, are still working during a genocide; don’t let their stories be forgotten. Watch this documentary from Zeteo to keep their legacy alive.
title: Documentary preserves stories of Gaza's healthcare workers under siege
